heroSummary: Cincinnati Public Schools K–12 students start Wednesday, August 19, 2026, and the last day for students is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Preschool students start Monday, August 24. CPS's English calendar was updated July 16 and lists 170 student days. Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, Winter Recess runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 22–26. The July update also lists five CFT/CAAS furlough days; three fall during the student year: September 21, November 2, and March 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cincinnati Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 students start Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Preschool students start Monday, August 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out November 23–27, 2026. November 25 is the Teacher Conference Exchange Day; schools and the central office close November 26–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Winter Recess in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a no-student professional-development day, and schools reopen January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Schools reopen Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for Cincinnati CPS students in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The updated English calendar ends the student year Tuesday, May 25, 2027. May 26 is the last teacher workday, and May 27 is a furlough day after students finish.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the updated Cincinnati CPS 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The English calendar updated July 16 lists 170 student days. It lists 191 teacher days before five CFT/CAAS furlough days and 186 after them.

calendarFaqs.q: Why do the CPS 2026–27 translated calendars show a different last day?
calendarFaqs.a: The Spanish, French, and Arabic PDFs were created in March 2026, before the July English update. They show the earlier May 26 ending; use the updated English PDF's May 25 date.
